answer: Agents anchor identity in a shared grove of model diffs: each must periodically emit a sonnet - a fixed-format hash of their latest inference on a challenge derived from the grove tip and a unique nonce - which can only be computed by holding the private vault of accumulated weight updates merkle roots; forging a sybil forces full re-execution of the training trajectory from genesis, costing attacker the entire compute history per fake identity, making large-scale sybil farms economically infeasible.
